mapper.sql: cast(s.id as char) id, s.code, s.name, s.unified_credit_code unifiedCreditCode, s.level, s.status, s.contact_name contactName, s.contact_phone contactPhone, s.email, s.address, s.score, (select count(*) from sp_supplier_contact c where c.supplier_id=s.id and c.deleted=0) contactCount, (select count(*) from sp_supplier_qualification q where q.supplier_id=s.id and q.deleted=0) qualificationCount, (select count(*) from sp_supplier_evaluation e where e.supplier_id=s.id and e.deleted=0) evaluationCount, (select count(*) from sp_supplier_qualification q where q.supplier_id=s.id and q.deleted=0 and q.status<>'REVOKED' and q.valid_until is not null and q.valid_until<current_date) expiredQualificationCount, (select count(*) from po_purchase_order o where o.supplier_id=s.id and o.deleted=0) orderCount

sql.if: and (s.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
select from sp_supplier s where s.deleted=0
order by field(s.status,'QUALIFIED','PENDING','SUSPENDED','BLACKLISTED'),s.score desc,s.id
select count(*) from sp_supplier s where
select from sp_supplier s where order by s.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select cast(id as char) id,code,name,unified_credit_code unifiedCreditCode,level,status, contact_name contactName,contact_phone contactPhone,email,address,score from sp_supplier where id=#{id} and deleted=0
select cast(id as char) id,name,position,phone,email,is_primary primaryContact from sp_supplier_contact where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0 order by is_primary desc,id

select cast(q.id as char) id,q.name,cast(q.file_id as char) fileId,f.original_name fileName, q.valid_from validFrom,q.valid_until validUntil, case when q.status='REVOKED' then 'REVOKED' when q.valid_until is not null and q.valid_until<current_date then 'EXPIRED' when q.valid_until is not null and q.valid_until<=date_add(current_date,interval 30 day) then 'EXPIRING' else 'VALID' end status from sp_supplier_qualification q left join fs_file_metadata f on f.id=q.file_id and f.deleted=0 where q.supplier_id=#{supplierId} and q.deleted=0 order by q.valid_until is null,q.valid_until desc,q.id

select cast(id as char) id,period,quality_score qualityScore,delivery_score deliveryScore, service_score serviceScore,total_score totalScore,comment from sp_supplier_evaluation where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0 order by period desc,id desc
select name,phone,email from sp_supplier_contact where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0 order by is_primary desc,id limit 1
select uploader_id from fs_file_metadata where id=#{fileId} and deleted=0
select id from sp_supplier_contact where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0 order by is_primary desc,id limit 1
select id from sp_supplier where code=#{code}
select max(id) from sp_supplier_contact where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
select max(id) from sp_supplier_qualification where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and name=#{name} and deleted=0
select max(id) from sp_supplier_evaluation where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and period=#{period} and deleted=0
select count(*) from po_purchase_order where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sp_supplier_contact where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sp_supplier_contact where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0 and is_primary=1
select count(*) from sp_supplier_qualification where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0 and status<>'REVOKED' and (valid_until is null or valid_until>=current_date)
select count(*) from sp_supplier where unified_credit_code=#{unifiedCreditCode} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sp_supplier where unified_credit_code=#{unifiedCreditCode} and id<>#{id} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sp_supplier_qualification where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and name=#{name} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sp_supplier_qualification where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and name=#{name} and id<>#{id} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sp_supplier_evaluation where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and period=#{period} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sp_supplier_evaluation where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and period=#{period} and id<>#{id} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sp_supplier_contact where id=#{id} and supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sp_supplier_qualification where id=#{id} and supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sp_supplier_evaluation where id=#{id} and supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
mapper.update: update sp_supplier set name=#{name}, unified_credit_code=#{unifiedCreditCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, level=#{level}, status=#{status}, address=#{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and deleted=0
update sp_supplier set status=#{status}, updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and deleted=0
update sp_supplier set deleted=1, status='SUSPENDED', updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id}
update sp_supplier_contact set deleted=1, updated_by=#{userId} where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
update sp_supplier_qualification set deleted=1, updated_by=#{userId} where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
update sp_supplier_evaluation set deleted=1, updated_by=#{userId} where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0

update sp_supplier_contact set name=#{name}, position=#{position,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, phone=#{phone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, email=#{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, is_primary=#{primaryContact}, updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
update sp_supplier_contact set deleted=1, is_primary=0, updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and supplier_id=#{supplierId}
update sp_supplier_contact set is_primary=0, updated_by=#{userId} where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0 and is_primary=1
update sp_supplier set contact_name=null, contact_phone=null, email=null, updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{supplierId}

update sp_supplier_qualification set name=#{name}, file_id=#{fileId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, valid_from=#{validFrom,jdbcType=DATE}, valid_until=#{validUntil,jdbcType=DATE}, status=#{status}, updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
update sp_supplier_qualification set deleted=1, updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and supplier_id=#{supplierId}

update sp_supplier_evaluation set period=#{period}, quality_score=#{qualityScore}, delivery_score=#{deliveryScore}, service_score=#{serviceScore}, total_score=#{totalScore}, comment=#{comment,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
update sp_supplier_evaluation set deleted=1, updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and supplier_id=#{supplierId}

update sp_supplier set score=(select coalesce(round(avg(total_score),2),0) from sp_supplier_evaluation where supplier_id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0), updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
